annotationRationale: The main task is to translate independent uniform choices into geometric probabilities. The primary route uses a triangular event region; the alternative partitions physical starting locations and weights their conditional probabilities. Triangle area belongs only to the primary route.

classificationReview.areaCheck: Counting & Probability is appropriate. No area repair is needed.

review.questionCheck: Independently, fixing any cardinal direction gives a favorable triangle of area 1/2 inside a parameter rectangle of area 6, so the probability is 1/12, choice B. The statement, independence assumptions and choices are consistent.
review.alternativeMethodCheck: The parameter-area route and the partition of physical starting locations are genuinely different accessible explanations. The references' averaging approach does not require an additional route.
review.annotationCheck: Uniform geometric probability is appropriately assessed. Total probability and rectangle area are supporting concepts; triangle area is correctly confined to the primary method.
review.areaCheck: Counting & Probability is appropriate. No area repair is needed.

methodReviews.mathCheck: Direction symmetry permits conditioning on east. Independence makes \((x,d)\) uniform in the stated area-6 rectangle. The event \(x+d>6\) has precisely the three listed triangle vertices and area 1/2. The equality boundary has probability zero, giving 1/12 overall.
methodReviews.sourceMethodCheck: The nonofficial LIVE and AoPS references support direction conditioning and boundary-distance comparison. The elementary parameter-area construction is an original reconstruction, correctly labeled source-informed-original, without relying on the references' informal mean-distance shortcuts.
methodReviews.pedagogyCheck: The explanation establishes the joint uniform model, translates escape into an inequality, identifies the triangle by coordinates and addresses the boundary. The words suffice without a diagram.
methodReviews.directNodeCheck: Geometric-probability covers the continuous area model; cnm_h246 supports averaging equal conditional direction probabilities; cnm_p148 and cnm_p089 cover the favorable and total areas.

nativeLayerJudgments.CN: The exact native links for total probability, triangle area and rectangle area fit the steps. Finite conditioning is explained accessibly despite the total-probability node's later curricular placement. The continuous probability synthesis has no supplied CN national link.
nativeLayerJudgments.US: The area calculations support portions of 6.G.A.1, 3.MD.C.7 and 4.MD.A.3. They do not demonstrate all polygon decomposition, tiling, perimeter or fractional-area requirements mentioned in the supplied links. No US link is supplied for continuous geometric probability or total probability.
nativeLayerJudgments.ailleo: Every immediate node is supported. The synthesis node captures the essential joint uniform model, while the remaining nodes describe actual supporting operations.

methodReviews.mathCheck: The regions have areas 16, 4 and 16, totaling 36. Conditional on each relevant region, the edge distance and independent hop distance are uniform on the same interval, so crossing probability is 1/2. Direction probabilities give regional escape probabilities 1/8 and 1/4. Their weighted sum is 1/12; boundaries contribute zero.
methodReviews.sourceMethodCheck: Correctly identifies nonofficial AoPS Solution 5 as the partition framework. The candidate independently supplies the exchange-symmetry justification for the distance probability, with appropriate source-informed-original attribution.
methodReviews.pedagogyCheck: The partition, uniform edge-distance observation and mutually exclusive direction choices are explained clearly. In particular, corner contributions are added without double-counting outcomes.
methodReviews.directNodeCheck: Geometric-probability, cnm_h246 and cnm_p089 precisely cover the area model, conditional weighting and rectangular region areas. Omitting triangle area from this route is correct.

nativeLayerJudgments.CN: The exact native rectangle-area and total-probability links fit the derivation. The continuous geometric probability component remains without a supplied CN national alignment.
nativeLayerJudgments.US: Rectangle multiplication and area addition overlap 3.MD.C.7 and the area portion of 4.MD.A.3. Perimeter and tiling requirements are not demonstrated. No supplied US link covers the exchange-symmetry probability argument or total probability.
nativeLayerJudgments.ailleo: The immediate nodes accurately capture both the continuous sampling model and the finite conditional partition. No unsupported triangle or coordinate concept is attached.
